title: SpecIR
description: Validated Specification IR — the output of the analysis phase. This is consumed by the orchestrator/codegen pipeline.

ir_version.description: Schema version of this IR document. See [`CURRENT_IR_VERSION`].

source_file.description: The parsed source file AST containing all declarations

type_mappings.description: Type mappings for the default target (typescript)

Expression.description: Expressions used in constraints, pre/postconditions, and test assertions.

GeneratorConfig.description: Configuration for generating constraint-aware arbitrary values. Extracted from refined type constraints to drive property-based test generators.

max.description: Maximum value for numeric ranges (from `range: [min, max]`)

min.description: Minimum value for numeric ranges (from `range: [min, max]`)

items.description: Specific items to import, or empty for wildcard `*`.

kind.description: Import kind: standard, relative, or registry.

target.description: Per-service target language override (`target rust`). `None` = use the build-wide target.
Per-service target language override; `None` = build-wide target.

Span.description: A byte-offset span in source code, used for error reporting.

generator.description: Generator configuration for property-based testing. Present only for refined types with constraints.

TypeMapping.description: A type mapping entry from OmniLang to a target language type.

import_path.description: Optional import/use path required for this type

TypeRef.description: A reference to a type, e.g. `String`, `List<Order>`, `Option<Int>`.

oneOf.description: Private — only visible within the declaring module.
